title: Integrate feature analyzer into DE10-Lite top-level
description: Instantiate fft_feature_analyzer in the DE10-Lite MAX 10 SystemCD top-level, connect the existing FFT stream, and expose MFCC/magnitude results through the selected board transport.

title: Implement FPGA audio feature analyzer for DE10-Lite
description: Replace Raspberry Pi magnitude/MFCC post-processing with a synthesizable FPGA module operating on streamed 512-bin complex FFT frames, using on-chip RAM and a documented fixed-point interface.
